evidence.grid_arithmetic_check: 612 mod 64 = 36 -> 612-36 = 576 = 9*64 OK; 807 mod 64 = 39 -> 807-39 = 768 = 12*64 OK; both observations fit cached = 64*floor(len/64) with zero free parameters

headline.answer_d_mechanism: The 64 grid is the recurrent-state checkpoint grid of a hybrid linear-attention model, not page alignment: cache_chunk_size = max(FLA chunk size 64, page_size=1) = 64, checkpoint_grid = lcm(64, 1) = 64, and match_prefix floors the full-KV hit onto that grid (floor(hit/64)*64), so cached = 64*floor(len/64) and uncached == len mod 64.
headline.flush: POST /flush_cache exists (timeout param, 400 if not idle). Blast radius = the whole server process for every tenant: it resets the shared radix tree, so any other user's next request pays a full cold prefill and any concurrent measurement of theirs is corrupted. No scoped/per-prefix flush. Do NOT call it; use a nonce prefix instead.
headline.biggest_pitfall: Coercing the absent prompt_tokens_details (SGLang omits it on a miss) to something other than 0 -- i.e. dropping null rows -- which silently deletes every cache miss and inflates the hit rate.
headline.second_pitfall: Cross-tenant contamination on a shared server: a 'cold' first request that already reports cached_tokens > 0. Only a fresh nonce prefix proves coldness.
headline.caveat_to_carry: The page_size=1 premise is INHERITED, not re-verified. page_size=64 would reproduce the identical 64-grid signature by pure radix-key alignment with no recurrent layer involved -- two read-only GETs (/server_info, /get_model_info) exclude it.
